_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the ClassiCube (MCGalaxy) egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: ClassiCube: MCGalaxy
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: MCGalaxy, the server software most ClassiCube servers run. Installs the current release from ClassiCube's download server, checked against its published checksum; levels, ranks, plugins and settings are kept.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MCGalaxy: downloads the current MCGalaxy release from ClassiCube's
# download server and checks it against the MD5 the server publishes for it.
# Levels, properties, ranks, plugins and the database are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
url=https://cdn.classicube.net/client/mcg/release/MCGalaxy.zip
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# The download server's ETag is the file's MD5.
etag=$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$url" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F'"' 'tolower($1) ~ /^etag: / { print $2 }') ||
    fail "ClassiCube's download server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ -n "$etag" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-mcgalaxy 2>/dev/null)" = "$etag" ] && [ -f MCGalaxy_.dll ]; then
    echo "The current MCGalaxy release is already installed."
    exit 0
fi
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading MCGalaxy"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/mcgalaxy.zip" "$url"
if [[ $etag =~ ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ ]]; then
    [ "$(md5sum "$build/mcgalaxy.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$etag" ] || fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi
unzip -q -j "$build/mcgalaxy.zip" -d "$build/x"
[ -f "$build/x/MCGalaxyCLI.exe" ] || fail "The download has no MCGalaxy in it."
cp -a "$build/x/." .
echo "$etag" > .raptor-mcgalaxy
echo "Installed the current MCGalaxy release."
